negative_reviews.author: Oscar
negative_reviews.text: Like Wagamama, if Wagamama was trying to take the piss out of the Japanese. Food and service was fine, but the entire atmosphere, from the comically large drum at the entrance, to the loud music, pink lighting and enormous geisha at the back of the restaurant seem curated for a perfectly instagramable experience conveniently distracting from the actual food. There was so much going on the food didn't leave much of an impression.

negative_reviews.author: Dani Jo
negative_reviews.text: The food was okay but quite salty and overcooked and undercooked at the same time. There wasn't any black garlic in the black garlic tonkotsu. The gyoza, while tasty, felt like it was cooked from frozen. The way it looks is amazing, but the music was really loud and I couldn't hear my partner.

negative_reviews.author: Lily Abed
negative_reviews.text:
Food was bland i had the chicken ramen, however to be fair the tempura starter was really good.
service was slow because when I ordered an alcoholic drink that had the bubble sitting on top, it was left sitting on their counter that by the time it came to our table it was just foam so felt dissapointed that i couldn't have the drink the way I saw its picture on the menu. Its not worth the hype, its nice visuals but the food isnt worth it.

negative_reviews.author: Danisan Sivakumar
negative_reviews.text:
It was my first visiting in Birmingham so I thought of trying food at your place. Very disappointed and felt like I was ignored and not welcomed. It was really busy so I requested the male manager (British tall man) that any chance I could sit in the corner I didn’t wanna sit in the middle of the crowd. He refused it and said that table is only for three people you can sit and was trying to seat me in the middle of a big group. I then refused and again requested to sit in the corner. Finally he did, no one came to take my order, felt like I was targeted.

While I was waiting to be served there were some Japanese couple came and he gave them a big table but it was only two people so I thought he is discriminating me. Finally a server came, she didn’t even ask whether I have any allergies, she took my order. I called the female manager and said that I have gluten intolerance so could you please guide me or explain the option but she didn’t. I ordered a stater, a main, a drink and a glass of water. Main came first no drinks at all, starter came later still no water or drink at all. By the time I started eating I asked more than 3 times that whether I could have my drinks at least.

Since I got allergy, after having the food, I was waiting to catch my train to come back home. I had server vomiting and diarrhoea in the train. It was because of their ignorance and careless behaviour. I said to that Chinese lady manager that I have allergy she didn’t even care about me. I’m gonna severely take action against their behaviour which is not suitable for the hospitality and I’m looking forward to the head office to contact me to discuss about my health issue.

There was another man who was trying to get the payment, he was like forcing me to pay the 10% service charge as if they gave the best guest experience. I would like to claim my full refund that I paid for the meal and I need a proper explanation form the management.
